data.body:
Implementation complete (TDD, all green). What landed:

1. compact_txn.py — absorbing re-fold semantics. New helpers along existing seams:
   _is_snapshot_path, _defer_presnapshot_foldables (f96b safety guard: pre-snapshot
   candidates NEVER fold without their governing snapshot — folding them alone would
   write a pre-snapshot SNAPSHOT the governing one positionally buries), and
   _ordered_fold_input (PINNED order: snapshots first, then all other candidates by
   timestamp — so a pre-snapshot late arrival replays ON TOP of the snapshot and the
   next snapshot cites it). _compact_locked now always reduces over that pinned
   override; _select_fold_set extracts the partition+guard (complexity ratchet green,
   new=0 increased=0).

2. compact.py — --absorb-orphans flag: bypasses ONLY the remote-SNAPSHOT refusal;
   sync-before-compact still runs; plain compact still refuses. Arg loop extracted to
   _parse_compact_flags (compact_cli was at C901=15 ceiling).

3. doctor.py — extends change 1771's shapes (based on refs/changes/71/1771/2):
   scan_orphans (read-only, reuses fsck_scan._check_snapshot so the doors cannot
   drift; kind=ORPHAN_EVENT with paths), _repair_orphans (backup ref via the shared
   _dirty_backup_ref BEFORE any mutation — no ref, no mutation; routes each damaged
   ticket to compact --absorb-orphans --threshold=0 --horizon=0; no outer lock —
   compact self-locks), _repair_store_level ordering: dirty first, then orphans, then
   link repairs.

Guards: a retired event is never a fold candidate (not *.json); a live event already
cited in source_event_uuids is uuid-skipped by replay — re-cited at most, never
re-applied (test pins both).

Tests: tests/unit/test_fold_race_orphan_absorb.py — 11 tests, RED-first verified
(8 failed pre-impl for the right reasons), now 11/11 green. Race reproduced
deterministically: hide the late comment file, fold, land it back committed as the
union merge would; assert show misses it + fsck ORPHAN_EVENT; then absorb/doctor
repair -> visible, fsck clean, backup ref present. Ordering pinned:
[c0, c1, middle(orphan), after].

Mutation pass (manual, 6 mutants, ALL KILLED): absorb-flag inversion (3 tests fail),
skipped/faked backup ref (2), ordering swap orphans-before-snapshot (6), defer-guard
removal (1), snapshot-predicate broken (7), doctor orphan-filter broken (2).

Validation: make lint green (ruff+format+ratchet active=53 new=0 increased=0),
make typecheck green (mypy 539 files), tests/unit -k "compact or doctor or fsck":
146 passed, 4 skipped.

Discovered+guarded latent hazard (the defer guard above): before this change a
re-fold could bury an orphan under a pre-snapshot SNAPSHOT silently and permanently
— now deferred until the governing snapshot ages out of the horizon.

Next: commit + push to Gerrit as WIP (1771 unmerged at last check).
